title: C1 Milestone 7: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el penúltimo Milestone del nivel C1. Dominas el 'Future in the Past' para explicar cambios de planes, la Pasiva de Reporte para distanciarte de rumores, y el vocabulario de Crisis y Cadena de Suministro.

parts.visual:
En este hito evaluaremos las lecciones 31 a 34 del nivel C1: 
- Future in the Past: We WERE GOING TO sign / The CEO WAS TO arrive / We thought it WOULD work. 
- Passive Voice in Reporting: IT IS BELIEVED that they won / The CFO IS SAID TO HAVE resigned / Prices ARE EXPECTED TO rise.
parts.audio: In this milestone we will evaluate lessons 31 to 34 of the C1 level. We will test your knowledge of Future in the Past, with structures like: We WERE GOING TO sign, The CEO WAS TO arrive, and We thought it WOULD work. We will also test Passive Voice in Reporting, with structures like: IT IS BELIEVED that they won, The CFO IS SAID TO HAVE resigned, and Prices ARE EXPECTED TO rise.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos vocabulario avanzado: 
- Crisis Management & PR (Damage control, backlash, product recall, transparency, whistleblower, scapegoat). 
- International Trade & Supply Chain (Procurement, tariffs, customs, freight, commodity, inventory). 
¡Este es el penúltimo paso antes del gran examen final de C1!
parts.audio: We will also review advanced vocabulary. From Crisis Management and PR: terms like damage control, backlash, product recall, transparency, whistleblower, and scapegoat. And from International Trade and Supply Chain: terms like procurement, tariffs, customs, freight, commodity, and inventory. This is the second to last step before the grand final C1 exam!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio avanzado de C1 en este examen integral.

questions.question: I ____ to email you yesterday, but my internet went down. (Iba a).
questions.explanation: Future in the past: Was going to.

questions.question: People say that the company is bankrupt. -> It ____ that the company is bankrupt.
questions.explanation: Pasiva impersonal: It is said that.

questions.question: The PR team immediately went into ____ control after the scandalous video leaked.
The ____ department is responsible for purchasing raw materials. (Adquisiciones).
The Prime Minister ____ to announce the new tax law, but postponed it. (Estaba programado que anunciara).
Journalists report that the hackers stole the data. -> The hackers are reported ____ the data.
questions.explanation: Robo pasado respecto al reporte -> to have stolen.

questions.question: The company faced severe public ____ when they raised the price of the life-saving drug. (Reacción negativa).
New government ____ on imported electronics will hurt our profit margins. (Aranceles).
I always believed that our startup ____ become a unicorn. (Predicción pasada).
Experts expect that inflation will rise. -> Inflation is expected ____.
Instead of blaming the CEO, they used the marketing director as a ____. (Chivo expiatorio).
Our goods have been stuck in ____ at the border for three days. (Aduanas).
We were just ____ to close the deal when they asked for a lower price. (A punto de).
They believe the CEO resigned yesterday. -> The CEO is believed ____ yesterday.
An employee leaked internal documents to the press; he acted as a ____. (Denunciante).
Shipping by sea ____ is much slower than by air. (Flete / Carga).
The delegates ____ to arrive this morning, but their flight was delayed. (Estaba programado).
People know she is very demanding. -> She is known ____ very demanding.
The company issued a product ____ because the brakes were defective. (Retirada).
The global ____ chain was disrupted by the port closure. (Cadena de suministro).
I ____ going to call. (Iba a)
He promised he ____ help. (Prometió que ayudaría)
____ is said that he won. (Se dice)
She is believed to ____ resigned. (Haber)
Damage ____. (Control con C)
Public ____. (Reacción negativa con B)
A product ____. (Retirada con R)
The ____ chain. (Suministro con S)
Import ____. (Aranceles con T)
Stuck in ____. (Aduanas con C)
